title: Groth16 proving-cost study: circuits, measurement harness, prover timers, cached-matrix prover and data
description: Artifact of the paper 'Proving Cost of Native and Non-Native Circuits in Groth16: Constraint Count, Matrix Density and Witness Values'. Circuits and generators (including RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 and ECDSA secp256k1 verifiers), the ZoKrates 0.8.7 measurement harness, the structure extractor, timer patches for the arkworks and bellman back ends, the cached-matrix prover, the Circom/snarkjs kit, the frozen predictions with checksums, statistics scripts and replicate-level results. Three files that contain ZoKrates standard-library code keep its LGPL-3.0 licence.
